title: DEBT-0003 CI needs: aggregation (all-gates single check for branch protection)

real_world_source.DEBT-0003: CI job 间无 needs: 声明 — 6 gate job 全并行，分支保护需锁定 6 个检查名而非 1 个

contract.r4_split_plan: 2 Spawn (≤6 锚点): [S1] Builder ci.yml 追加 all-gates 聚合 job (1 锚点 +8 行) [S2] Tester 新建 tests/test_ci_workflow.py (3 测试) → S3 Reviewer 独立审计
contract.scope_decision: AUDIT 侦察确认 6 gate job 无数据依赖链 → 修复方向是聚合 job 而非链式 needs; pyyaml 为核心依赖 → 测试可安全解析 YAML

targets..github/workflows/ci.yml: 追加 all-gates job: name 'All Gates Passed', needs: [6 gate jobs], echo step; 6 gate jobs 零改动
targets.tests/test_ci_workflow.py: 3 测试: all-gates 存在; needs 覆盖全部 6 gate; 6 gate job 均已定义 (GATE_JOBS 显式常量)

acceptance: pytest tests/ 全量 (178 + 3 = 181 预期)
YAML 语义独立解析: set(needs) == set(jobs) - {all-gates}, 恰好 7 jobs
git diff ci.yml 仅 +8 行追加 (6 gate job 名零改动)
GATE 7 policy_sync PASS (4 prefixes) — CI 变更不影响代码漂移门
git status 仅 2 文件 (ci.yml + test_ci_workflow.py)

history.summary: S1 Builder (ci.yml +8 行 all-gates, YAML_OK needs=6), S2 Tester (3 测试全绿, 全量 181), S3 Reviewer APPROVE (7 项独立审计全过). DEBT-0003 清偿 → 债务账本 8/8 全清零里程碑. R5/R6 第三轮应用, 双 Spawn 无 BLOCKED. A2 note: .aionui/ 有意图地被 git 跟踪 (32 文件审计轨迹, 保持).
